Priya K: Quick Q — I'm a part-time contractor (3 days/week). Spring Bank Holiday (May 27) fell during our year-end blackout and I couldn't take it. Can that bank holiday be carried over or is it lost? cc @People Ops
People Ops: Hey Priya — short answer: bank holidays that land inside a company-wide blackout follow the blackout exception process. For part-time and fixed-term contractors we pro-rate accruals and can either carry the day over or payout, but it needs manager + HR approval. Please file the blackout exception form so we have it on record.
Priya K: Thanks — it's May 27, 2026 and I'm on a fixed-term contract. Manager said we were staffed for a client rotation so couldn't schedule the day.
People Ops: Got it. Please use the form `hr-forms/blackout-exception` (https://intranet.redwood/hr-forms/blackout-exception) and attach your contract + a short manager note. Policy excerpt below for context:
```
Policy (excerpt):
- Part-time/contractors accrue holidays pro rata.
- If a statutory or company bank holiday falls during a mandatory blackout and the individual could not reasonably take leave, HR may approve carryover or equivalent payout.
- Approvals require manager confirmation and HR sign-off. Payroll payout deadlines may apply.
```
People Ops: Once you submit we'll calculate the pro-rated entitlement. Example: 3/5 FTE = 0.6 of a full-day bank holiday. We'll confirm exact hours with payroll.
Sam H: I can confirm — Priya was on the client rotation that week and couldn't take the day. Sam H: +1 to carryover, happy to sign the manager confirmation on the form. :thumbsup:
People Ops: Thanks Sam — I've created HR case #HR-2026-4823 and assigned it to the Benefits team. Priya, when you submit set the "resolution" field to "carryover" and attach Sam's confirmation. We'll aim to close within 2 pay cycles.
Priya K: Appreciate it. Is there a deadline for submitting this? Payroll cutoffs are tight for me.
People Ops: For blackout-related carryover requests, submit within 30 days of blackout end for the same calendar year for standard handling. Payroll payout requests should be in by Nov 1 for inclusion in Dec payroll; late submissions may be deferred to the next cycle. If you're cutting it close, flag the form as "urgent" and we can expedite.
calendar-bot: Reminder — company year-end blackout window: Dec 24–Jan 2 (company-wide) — see https://calendar.redwood/blackout-windows
Ethan L: Does the same carryover/payout logic apply for our EU offices? We had Easter Monday fall inside a local blackout week.
People Ops: Policy is global but we respect local statutory rules. In some countries local labor law requires payout rather than carryover. For EU cases please cc your local manager and HR partner; we'll treat per-country and advise on whether a payout is mandatory.
Priya K: Submitted the form and attached Sam's note. Marked as urgent. Thanks for the quick help!
People Ops: Received. We'll confirm pro-rated hours and update HR-2026-4823 once payroll has scheduled the adjustment. Expect an update in 3–10 business days. :white_check_mark:
